description: This plot illustrates the validation performance, measured in BPC, of two models, SMoE and SimSMoE, over the course of training. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps ($x10^3$)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "BPC" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from 1.2 to 2.2, featuring tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The solid black line with cross markers represents "SMoE Validating." It begins at approximately x=1 with a y-value of 1.68, experiences a steep decline to reach y=1.2 at x=19, drops slightly to 1.17 at x=20, and then maintains a steady, nearly flat trend with minor fluctuations, ending at approximately y=1.14 at x=49. The solid magenta line with dot markers represents "SimSMoE Validating." It starts at x=0 with a y-value of 2.16, sharply declines to y=1.19 at x=19, drops to 1.15 at x=20, and then follows a steady, nearly flat trend with minor fluctuations, concluding at approximately y=1.11 at x=49.
